Regional variation is a prominent theme in the evaluation of ADHD care and outcomes across Denmark's five healthcare regions. The data highlights significant disparities in clinical indicators, educational achievements, and patient volumes between [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]].

Clinical indicators show substantial geographic differences. For [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], regional results vary widely, ranging from 10% in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] to 34% in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src1]. Similarly, [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] demonstrates considerable regional variation, with rates spanning from 32% in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] to 70% in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src2]. For [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]], among regions with a minimum of three patients, results fluctuate from 0% in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] to 4% in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src5], while in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], psychotherapy was deemed relevant for fewer than three patients in total [^src5]. Another unspecified regional metric showed results varying from 18% in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] to 50% in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], with [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] closely behind at 49% [^src4].

Educational outcomes for young people in the [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] and [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] also reflect these regional divides. The highest proportion of passed graduation exams (afgangseksaminer) among youth in the [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] is found in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (63%), while the lowest is in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (47%) [^src3]. This pattern holds true for the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]], where [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] again leads with 69%, and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] records the lowest rate at 49% [^src3].

Furthermore, the volume of patient pathways differs significantly across the regions. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] manages 2,321 assessment pathways (udredningsforløb) and 647 patients in package pathways (pakkeforløb) [^src6]. In contrast, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] handles 1,171 assessment pathways and a higher number of 841 patients in package pathways [^src6]. These variations underscore the diverse operational scales and clinical outcomes characterizing ADHD services across the Danish healthcare regions.
